en.title: How to structure deliverables and publications
en.lead: A scalable content model for organising deliverables, publications and outputs that grows naturally with the project.

sections.heading: Start with the content model
paragraphs: Define the fields that every deliverable and publication needs before designing any page:
after: A consistent content model is what allows filtering, listing and reuse across the site to work.

sections.heading: Design for browsing, not just searching
paragraphs: Most visitors do not arrive knowing exactly what they want. Provide clear filters by work package, type and year, and surface the most recent and most downloaded items.
